record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare SOFT_BOILED in this production reference (passive NONE in the catalog; maxPP 120, range 1). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: Team shield and cleanse. For every non-null same-team board entity, the caster included, in this order: a broadcast, addShield(shield, caster, apBoost 1, crit) with shield 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 (fallback 160), then clearNegativeStatus(recipient, caster). The recipient's Big Eater Belt applies BEFORE the caster's AP and crit, then recipient enrage, rounding and the alive gate; shields are not heals, so Protect and wound do not block them. The cleanse zeroes cooldowns, not most flags. The loop has no HP filter: a unit at 0 HP gets no shield but is still cleansed. No damage or heal.

targeting.who: all units of the caster's team on the board, including the caster
targeting.note: requiresTarget = false, so the cast does not need an enemy in range; the target argument is null. Which condition decides when it can start (PP gate, silence) was only read at the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate.

geometry.note: iterates every board cell; no distance or position filter

effects.scaling: requested amount (raw) -> Big Eater Belt on the receiver (positive value, x1.25 rounded down) -> AP: x (1 + AP/100) with apBoost 1 using the CASTER's AP -> crit: x critPower if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT) -> x0.5 if the receiver is enraged -> Math.round. Same crit flag for every receiver.
effects.resolution: requested raw amount vs applied: the shield added to each receiver is the rounded result of the chain above, per receiver (item and enraged state differ); added to the existing shield (floor 0); only if the receiver's hp > 0. Nothing in this strategy reads the result, and no damage is involved.

statusEffects.target: each unit of the caster's team (the caster included)
statusEffects.guards: no immunity or Rune Protect check; the boolean flags (burn, wound, ...) stay set until each status updates; the curse cooldown gets +2000 ms; the possession check compares the recipient's team with the supplied caster's team, so it is not a judgement about whether a possession is beneficial (executed: an active possession cooldown is kept)
statusEffects.combatEffect: cooldowns of burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, locked and blind are set to 0

shields.target: every own-team unit including the caster

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry (160, also the fallback) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (bare stars 1, 2, 3). maxPP is 120 and range 1 for all.

record.positionalConditions: None. The effect applies to the whole own team on the board, whatever the distance.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast adds a new shield on top of whatever shield remains and clears the status cooldowns again.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw shield: 20/40/80 by stars (20 Happiny, 40 Chansey, 80 Blissey). Requested per receiver: that amount. Applied per receiver: Big Eater Belt x1.25 (round down) if held, then x(1 + caster AP/100), x critPower if the cast crit, x0.5 if enraged, rounded; zero effect on receivers with hp <= 0. Statuses: cooldowns set to 0 (curse extended by 2000 ms if its cooldown was running).

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (addShield, clearNegativeStatus, the Belt helper, Board.forEach) and the real SoftBoiledStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_D1); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in board): the per-unit order, the shield values with Belt / AP / crit / enrage, the alive gate, Protect and wound, and the cooldown-only cleanse with the possession keep.
